_comment: THE DEFAULT. Every other settings file in this folder extends this one and changes a few fields.
Run it unchanged and it reproduces Plunkett et al. (2025) on Qwen3-0.6B: 4-bit, fp16, sized for a Colab T4.
The six blocks mirror the paper's environment frame (object, decision_rule, model_training,
model_estimating, report_schema, model_hyperparameters), plus gates and compute.
Every field the pipeline reads is listed here, so this file is the whole list of settings. A rule,
estimator or report schema may take more fields of its own (a threshold rule's cut_range, an
estimator's grid_step, a schema's batches); those are set in the file that names that component.
Every value with a Plunkett source is his value; README 'Settings' gives the source of each field.
To make a new experiment: copy a file, change one element, name the copy after the change.
